'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Rarity|Rare]] [[Spells|Spell]] of [[Spell Types|Type]]: Spell Passive. It has no effect while in a wand, but it can be used as a "wildcard" during Fusion to upgrade another spell, like the [[Mimicry Cube]] being able to duplicate a spell's effect while equipped in a wand.

While it is a Rare, {{PAGENAME}} can be used as a wildcard for both Normal and Rare spells. The upgrade level of the {{PAGENAME}} must match the level of the spell being upgraded (i.e. a Level+ {{PAGENAME}} can only be used for fusing a Level+ spell into Level++, and cannot work on a base level spell).

{{PAGENAME}} cannot be fused up to a Level++ version as that would make no sense since no spell can be upgraded further than ++.
